posts.t: Trading is a business, so plan the trade, trade the plan. I've found that trading is more mental than anything. I've had more than my share of trades that have been up 1,2 even 4 R, only to scratch or lose. I think the key to making money in the markets is to find an edge like RTM, create a trading plan, then execute it diligently so that, like a real job, it becomes boring. I'm here to make money, lots of it I hope. Not to worry, I've got my charities picked out once I'm able to afford them. So, onwards...

posts.t:
2 really important concepts that I've picked up reading thru various journals of Master traders

1) After engulf, price is free to move to origin of EG in that TF 2) Price likes to go 'coast-to-coast'

So the implication is, if there's an engulf of a H1 level, price is free to move back to the origin of that EG in the H1 TF or the FTR of that DP. Which means don't diddle in the middle of that TF when price hasn't reached its objective yet unless there's another EG which takes precedence
posts.fa:
2 مفهوم واقعاً مهم که از خواندن ژورنال‌های مختلف معامله‌گران استاد یاد گرفتم

1) بعد از اینگالف، قیمت آزاد است تا به مبدأ EG در همان TF برود 2) قیمت دوست دارد «از یک کرانه به کرانهٔ دیگر» برود

پس نتیجه این است که اگر سطحی در H1 اینگالف شود، قیمت آزاد است تا به مبدأ همان EG در TF H1 یا FTR همان DP برگردد. یعنی وقتی قیمت هنوز به هدفش نرسیده، وسط محدودهٔ آن TF بی‌جهت معامله نکن، مگر اینکه EG دیگری باشد که اولویت داشته باشد

posts.t: Wow, after reading like 4 Master Trader journals this weekend, I feel the fog lifting and can now start to gaze out near the horizon. Going thru my list of symbols again I saw this CADJPY map so clearly. So here's the plan: Pre-CP was engulfed @ purple X which means price should get to lower green demand box. This also means that price could get to the FTR preceding the EG or supply #1. Since there's a monthly swap level above this(green dashed line), I'll be on the lookout for a FO into the FL around the swap(it's there). If price somehow engulfs supply #3, I then can start hunting longs to take out the tip of the higher CP or supply #4. I feel like I have a crystal ball into PA now. Now comes the hard part, actually putting the plan into action and staying the course!

posts.t: OK, this is one setup to pin up on the wall and look at EVERY day to ingrain the important aspects of RTM: 1) Trick Played in past creates a nice MPL 2) price approaches the MPL but backs off and engulfs the FTR. So FOF says price wants higher to MPL 3) price hits MPL, SL == 8-10 pips 4) TG1 = 5R, TG2 = 10R, TG3 = 15R

posts.t: OK, I see the problem. Your entry was correct but why did you exit the trade? According to RTM concepts, your target(s) should have been lower than where you TPed. FOF is about understanding where the clean orders lie. Once into a trade, then you need to use trade management to figure out how to TP. My understanding is that Salivan uses regular RTM methods for his targets. Bill

posts.t: Here's a question I have regarding making PA in this scale: in the chart below, FLs A, B, C are all bullish and FTR D is bearish. They all either overlap or envelope each other. If price engulfs FL C south, is that valid PA or would it have to engulf FL A? I'm assuming that all FLs are drawn correctly and that there's no space to work with at this scale. I think the answer is no for FL C but at a smaller scale, it would be valid. Bill
posts.fa: دربارهٔ شکل‌گیری PA در این مقیاس سؤالی دارم: در نمودار زیر، سطوح FL با برچسب‌های A، B، C همگی صعودی‌اند و FTR با برچسب D نزولی است. همهٔ آن‌ها یا با هم هم‌پوشانی دارند یا یکدیگر را در بر می‌گیرند. اگر قیمت FL C را رو به پایین اینگالف کند، آیا این PA معتبر است یا باید FL A را اینگالف کند؟ فرض من این است که همهٔ سطوح FL درست رسم شده‌اند و در این مقیاس فضایی برای کار وجود ندارد. فکر می‌کنم پاسخ برای FL C منفی است، اما در مقیاس کوچک‌تر معتبر خواهد بود. Bill
